Learning to garden is always helpful as well. Learn to save seeds while you're at it.

While the "Beans, Bullets, and Band Aids" approach is certainly worthy of praise and is the most popular one you'll likely hear, I recommend a different one:

You should start with preparing YOURSELF.

Get healthy. Get fit. Practice skills and learn to think calmly in the midst of chaos. No chaos in your life? Create a bit of "mini chaos" so that if and when the "real" thing hits, you have some experience in dealing with it.

Beans, bullets and band aids are great, but won't do you much good if you've never had to live on beans, never shot a gun, or never treated a wound...under a stressful situation. Your mind and body are the first thing to prepare. Then you can move on to those other things.

I know this may not be a popular idea, but it made sense for me and was the path I followed. Hope it gives you some ideas so you can find your own.

Get yourself a BOB, then work towards building up an INCH bag.

Start stockpiling, but most importantly of all - get a plan, and then learn the skills and do the drills that will allow that plan to succeed.
